_comment: DefenseStoplightNotify@v1 — operator-owned delivery policy for the inverse-hedge stoplight desk
(scripts/defense_inverse_stoplights.py, 17:55 ET weekdays). SHADOW since 2026-07-18; promoted to Telegram
by the operator on 2026-10-31 (DSN-20261031-market-risk-engine P0-T7, design §11 item 4; decision recorded in
config/promote_criteria.json). Only the transitions listed here send; everything else stays desk-only telemetry.
The ENTRY 'DAY 1 OF 2' shadow substate is deliberately absent: the pre-registered backtest rejected the two-day
rule as a gate. Advisory only — a card never carries a size, order or stop value (MBI_BEHAVIOR = 0).
